mutants.old: double brim_width = !config.tree_support_auto_brim ? tree_brim_width : std::max(MIN_BRANCH_RADIUS_FIRST_LAYER, std::min(node.radius + node.dist_mm_to_top / (scale * branch_radius) * 0.5, MAX_BRANCH_RADIUS_FIRST_LAYER) - node.radius);
mutants.description: The public auto-brim row must produce a smaller first support-base area than the explicit 16 mm row. Replacing the auto branch with the explicit width removes the bounded first-layer calculation and should fail that geometry comparison.

With the public rectilinear base pattern pinned, the wall-count-2 row must emit more closed support loops on non-first support layers than the wall-count-1 row. Replacing the generate_toolpaths wall count with zero suppresses the second _make_loops() offset and should fail the closed-loop witness.
